_comment: Single source of truth for the on-disk dataset layout. Consumed by tools/verify_setup.py and tests/test_project_setup.m so the Python tooling and the MATLAB pipeline cannot drift apart. Paths are relative to the data root (see config/drishti_paths.m). Counts were verified 2026-09-11 and cross-checked against the published dataset specifications.
